column7: Template render: a storage fault in the per-reference permission check (a share read, or a transient RBAC lookup failure folded into a denial) was folded into ErrSecretRefNotFound, so a global secrets.read holder got 404 "no such secret" for a secret that exists and the denial row said forbidden. stageRenderRef now returns secretRefCheckFault: it renders as and matches only ErrSecretRefNotFound (the #181 answer stays byte-identical for every other mapper), carries the ErrStorageReadUnavailable for the holder branch (503 + Retry-After), and the denial is audited internal_error. Red on unmodified main (404 for both fault kinds). Core half: TestRenderSecretTemplate_PermissionCheckFaultIsNotAVerdict. CORE-FAULT-TAILS-1 item 1 (REVFIX-3948 leftover).
